messages:
andrew: Quick preflight — pushing a small tuning patch to rollout engine at 08:00 PT tomorrow. Short changelog: reduced default batch size from 32 -> 24 for low-latency routes, adjusted kv-cache TTL for chat sessions, fixed race in warmup handshake. No user-visible changes expected. @eng-sre @eng-platform please watch canary.

sophia: Thanks. Can we get a 30m canary window on dedicated and hosted? Recommend 10% traffic on canary lanes. I'll update rollout config and post the plan in Console.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: rollout_id=r12345, start=1748605800, steps=[10,30,60], notify=@eng-releases

kai: Oncall will watch latency dashboards. I'll set alert thresholds: p95 > 220ms for text-gen route and error rate > 0.5% on any lane.

raj: Infra note: increasing autoscale buffer on dedicated pools during canary to avoid eviction spikes. Will monitor GPU utilization and headroom.

mike: Add a rollback flag to the rollout command. Example run: `./rollout --id r12345 --timeout 1800 --rollback-on=error,latency`. Tested locally against staging.

sophia: Also instituting a 3h post-canary freeze for non-critical deploys to let metrics settle. I'll pin the freeze window in the console.

dana: Product ack. QA: anything here that would affect our long-chat regression harnesses?

andrew: QA note — kv-cache TTL tweak could affect long-chat session tests. QA-team, please run long-session regression with seq lengths 2k-8k and check token continuity.

kai: If anything looks off I'll escalate. I'll post snapshots to #incidents and tag eng-sre. Ping me @kai for severity 2.

sophia: TL;DR: preflight tuning + canary at 08:00 PT, 10% → 30% → 60%, 30m canary window then 1h watch, then 3h deploy freeze. Action owners: andrew (lead), sophia (release mgr), kai (oncall), raj (infra), mike (eng-sre), qa-team.

andrew: Thanks all — will post a short readiness update 30m before start :thumbsup:
